bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/compression.rs (encode_buffer, encode_buffer_threaded, decode_buffer, decode_buffer_limited, Stream, InputFilter, OutputFilter), springboard/sdk/src/compression/dynamic.rs (Level, encode, encode_threaded), springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/inflate.rs (inflate, zlib), springboard/src/files/zip.rs (create, extract), springboard/src/pngenc.rs (zlib_stored)
summary: BifrOSt has DEFLATE and zlib encoding and decoding for apps through bifrost_app::compression, with a dynamic-Huffman encoder at three levels and an optional thread count for large inputs, and streams and filters. DEFLATE, zlib and LZ4 streams are incremental and can be flushed; LZMA streams run on finalize. It has LZ4 (block, buffer framing, and the LZ4 frame format) and LZMA (the xz container around LZMA2, with CRC32, CRC64 and SHA-256 checks) but no LZFSE or Brotli codecs, and no compression for the Files app zip writer or the PNG writer. bifrost_app::archive_format adds a BifrOSt archive container over these codecs.

features.note: DEFLATE and zlib only; takes a Level and a thread count; returns a Vec, so no scratch buffer. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-20 zlib_header_second_byte_follows_the_level, zlib_trailer_is_the_big_endian_adler32_of_the_input, threads_change_the_bytes_but_never_the_decoded_data, every_codec_and_level_round_trips_every_sample; parity_sdk-tests-04 every_level_and_algorithm_round_trips, zlib_header_flevel_follows_the_level, zlib_trailer_is_the_adler32_of_the_input, one_thread_gives_the_same_bytes_as_the_single_step_call. Not yet verified on Midget.

DEFLATE and zlib only; output is capped at inflate::MAX_OUT (256 MiB) or a caller-given limit. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-20 the_reference_zlib_bytes_decode_to_hello, the_decode_limit_is_inclusive_and_one_byte_less_refuses, a_deflate_stream_cut_short_is_truncated, zlib_header_with_a_method_other_than_deflate_is_invalid; parity_sdk-tests-04 zlib_reference_bytes_decode_to_hello, decode_limit_is_inclusive_and_refuses_one_byte_more, decode_reports_truncated_input. Not yet verified on Midget.

features.apple: compression_algorithm, Algorithm (LZFSE, LZ4, LZ4_RAW, LZMA, ZLIB)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/compression.rs (Algorithm); springboard/sdk/src/compression/lz4.rs (LZ4 block, bv41/bv4-/bv4$ buffer framing, LZ4 frame, xxHash32); springboard/sdk/src/compression/lzma.rs (xz container, LZMA2 decoder and encoder, CRC32, CRC64); springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-20.rs; springboard/sdk/tests/compression_lz4.rs; springboard/sdk/tests/compression_lzma.rs
features.note: LZMA is implemented as the xz container around LZMA2 (lzma.rs): a decoder for every LZMA2 chunk kind, the stream, block, index and footer checks, CRC32, CRC64 and SHA-256 checks, and an encoder with a greedy hash-chain matcher, a range encoder and a CRC64 check (lc=3, lp=0, pb=2). The level and the thread count are ignored. No xz stream made by an external tool is in the repository, so there is no external test vector: the tests cover round trips, the CRC32 and CRC64 check values, refusals and limits, and the bytes are not yet checked against another xz implementation. LZ4 is implemented (greedy block encoder, bounds-checked decoder, bv41/bv4-/bv4$ buffer framing, LZ4 frame helper with xxHash32). LZFSE, LZBITMAP and Brotli are still unsupported and fail with Unsupported. Zlib, raw Deflate, LZ4 and LZMA are wired through encode_buffer, decode_buffer_limited, Stream and the filters. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-20 zlib_raw_deflate_lz4_and_lzma_are_supported, unsupported_algorithms_are_named_in_every_buffer_and_stream_entry_point; parity_sdk-tests-04 unsupported_algorithms_fail_in_every_entry_point; compression_lz4 (host unit tests, not yet run); compression_lzma (host tests, not yet run). Not yet verified on Midget. Update 2026-10-19: LZ4 streams and filters are now incremental (see the stream row); the LZ4 and LZMA codecs themselves are unchanged. Brotli and LZFSE stay Unsupported on purpose: Brotli needs its 122 KB static dictionary, which is not in the tree, and an LZFSE codec cannot be checked here without reference vectors, so no half-compatible codec was added. Midget check: on Titan build the SDK unit-test binary with `cargo test --offline --profile fast -p bifrost-app --lib --no-run`, copy the executable it prints to Midget with `scp`, and run `ssh midget ./<that executable> compression::lz4 --test-threads 1`; every test passes.

A compress stream returns each block as soon as 65535 bytes of input are in, and a decompress stream returns output as soon as each symbol completes. The decoder is a resumable state machine (compression/inflate_stream.rs) that rolls back a unit needing more input. Output does not depend on how the input is split into writes. Built 2026-10-19: Stream::flush (DEFLATE and zlib write the pending block and an empty stored block, the sync flush 00 00 ff ff; LZ4 closes its partial block) so a decoder reaches every byte written so far while the stream stays open; and LZ4 streams are now incremental (Bv4Encoder emits a bv41 or bv4- block per 64 KiB, Bv4Decoder takes any split, keeps 64 KiB of history, refuses block sizes past 16 MiB, output past the limit, unknown magic and bytes after the end marker). Still missing: LZMA streams run on finalize, and there is no flush for a decompress stream (it already returns every complete byte). Tests: inline compression.rs a_flushed_compress_stream_is_decodable_before_it_is_finalized, an_lz4_compress_stream_returns_full_blocks_before_finalize_and_gives_the_one_shot_bytes, an_lz4_decompress_stream_reports_damage_as_it_arrives_and_stops_at_the_limit; lz4.rs the_incremental_encoder_gives_the_buffer_bytes_for_any_split, a_flush_lets_the_decoder_reach_the_input_so_far, the_incremental_decoder_takes_the_input_one_byte_at_a_time, the_incremental_decoder_follows_matches_across_blocks, the_incremental_decoder_refuses_hostile_input; dynamic.rs a_sync_flush_lets_a_decoder_reach_every_byte_written_so_far. Not compiled or run in this round. Midget check: on Titan build the SDK unit-test binary with `cargo test --offline --profile fast -p bifrost-app --lib --no-run`, copy the executable it prints to Midget with `scp`, and run `ssh midget ./<that executable> compression:: --test-threads 1`; every test passes; the flush and LZ4 stream tests are among them.

The input filter asks its source for capacity-sized pieces, and only as far as the reader needs. The output filter sends output as each write completes it. Bad input fails the call that reaches it, and later reads fail the same way. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-20 an_input_filter_serves_the_decoded_data_in_requested_sizes, an_input_filter_drains_its_source_in_buffer_sized_requests (the source is asked for capacity-sized pieces), an_input_filter_failure_is_sticky, an_output_filter_delivers_the_result_in_chunks_of_the_capacity, an_output_filter_refuses_writes_and_a_second_finalize_after_finishing, an_output_filter_leaves_the_sink_untouched_when_the_data_is_invalid; inline compression.rs input_filter_pulls_input_only_as_far_as_the_reader_needs, output_filter_reports_bad_input_on_the_write_that_has_it. Not yet verified on Midget. Built 2026-10-19: OutputFilter::flush sends everything written so far to the sink as output a decoder can decode in full and leaves the filter open (an_output_filter_flush_sends_decodable_output_to_the_sink); LZ4 filters are incremental, so an input filter reads LZ4 data from its source only as far as the reader needs and an output filter sends each 64 KiB block as it fills. LZMA filters still run on finalize. Midget check: on Titan build the SDK unit-test binary with `cargo test --offline --profile fast -p bifrost-app --lib --no-run`, copy the executable it prints to Midget with `scp`, and run `ssh midget ./<that executable> compression::tests::an_output_filter --test-threads 1`; every test passes.

Lazy LZ77 (one byte of lookahead) at Default and Best, greedy at Fast, over a 32 KiB window, with dynamic Huffman blocks. A block is written stored when that is smaller than the Huffman form. The levels set the chain depth. Still missing: no optimal parsing, and each block has its own tables only. Tests: inline dynamic.rs lazy_levels_round_trip_and_are_deterministic, incompressible_input_is_stored_within_five_bytes_per_block, streamed_output_does_not_depend_on_the_write_sizes; parity_sdk-tests-20 repetitive_text_compresses_far_below_its_size_at_every_level. The Files app zip writer still uses its own fixed-Huffman encoder (springboard/src/files/zip.rs:331). Not yet verified on Midget. Update 2026-10-19: the encoder has a sync flush (Encoder::flush: the pending block, then an empty stored block; later matches still reach back over it), tested by dynamic.rs a_sync_flush_lets_a_decoder_reach_every_byte_written_so_far and flushing_with_nothing_pending_is_just_the_empty_stored_block. Midget check: on Titan build the SDK unit-test binary with `cargo test --offline --profile fast -p bifrost-app --lib --no-run`, copy the executable it prints to Midget with `scp`, and run `ssh midget ./<that executable> compression::dynamic --test-threads 1`; every test passes.

zlib_compressed codes PNG output with a fixed-Huffman deflate block and LZ77 back references; headless tests in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-complete-43.rs decode the output with the png crate. Gap: there are no dynamic Huffman blocks and no compression levels.

Decode failures are reported by the call that sees them (write, process or read), not only at finalize. The encode side can fail only with Unsupported at init; writes after finalize report Finished or InvalidState. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-20 error_messages_name_each_failure, zlib_header_whose_check_bits_do_not_divide_by_31_is_invalid, zlib_header_that_asks_for_a_preset_dictionary_is_invalid, a_decompress_stream_reports_bad_input_as_soon_as_it_arrives, an_output_filter_leaves_the_sink_untouched_when_the_data_is_invalid; inline compression.rs output_filter_reports_bad_input_on_the_write_that_has_it, a_truncated_decompress_stream_fails_at_finalize_and_then_is_finished. Not yet verified on Midget. Update 2026-10-19: LZ4 decompress streams report bad input on the write that has it (unknown magic, a block size past 16 MiB or the limit, a size field that disagrees with the block, bytes after the end marker) and a stream cut short fails at finalize with Truncated. Midget check: on Titan build the SDK unit-test binary with `cargo test --offline --profile fast -p bifrost-app --lib --no-run`, copy the executable it prints to Midget with `scp`, and run `ssh midget ./<that executable> compression::lz4 --test-threads 1`; every test passes.

App-facing module for buffers, streams and filters. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-20 (imports bifrost_app::compression and checks buffer, stream and filter results); parity_sdk-tests-04 (every test in the file uses bifrost_app::compression, for example zlib_reference_bytes_decode_to_hello and compress_stream_returns_everything_on_the_finalizing_call). Not yet verified on Midget.
tied to Apple's C buffer API; Rust Vec output needs no scratch size

gaps: No LZFSE or Brotli codec in either direction (LZ4 block and frame and LZMA2 in an xz container are implemented); Brotli needs a static dictionary that is not in the tree, LZFSE has no reference vectors here
LZMA streams buffer their input and run on finalize; DEFLATE, zlib and LZ4 streams are incremental with a flush
DEFLATE encoder has no optimal parsing and no table sharing across blocks; output is larger than zlib at its best level
PNG writer uses a fixed-Huffman deflate (springboard/src/pngenc.rs), not the SDK dynamic encoder
Files app zip writer does not use the SDK encoder yet, so its archives are fixed-Huffman
